deferred_reason: Baseline duplicate-error parity defect was fixed separately in correction/; this archive retains the original pre-correction source and has no build or measurement approval.

implementation.backend: unchecked quick-xml parser through the third item, then a lazy BTreeMap seeded from raw key slices
implementation.early_duplicate_preflight: key_at mirrors quick-xml's key/equal prefix before every backend value parse
implementation.first_two_iterator: quick-xml Attributes with duplicate checks disabled
implementation.late_handoff: ordered BTreeMap starts at the fourth item after the third successful item seeds three names
implementation.phase_layout: two usize short-prefix payload; boxed BTreeMap backend is lazy; direct probe must measure the resulting layout
implementation.replay: none; prior values are never reparsed or consumed as hidden seeds
implementation.seed: first and second keys come from raw key prefixes addressed by first_end; third key comes from its borrowed Attribute key

required_gates: canonical quick-xml differential and first-error tests
third and later transition lexical/error tests
duplicate-before-value preflight tests after the third item
clone and FusedIterator exhaustion tests across every phase
long prior values with no source-level replay path
fresh public workflow, resource, and cross-format evidence before any adoption
tradeoffs: first and second successful items scan only the raw tail prefix needed for the next key
the third key is preflighted before its value is parsed
a third successful item with a non-whitespace tail allocates and seeds the ordered map from raw keys
the ordered backend checks every later name with O(log n) comparisons and never replays an earlier value
the candidate may correct the known leading-equals late duplicate discrepancy in the current baseline; this is documented and must be reviewed separately
